# T088P133 contribution review round 1 — SUBSTANTIAL (conditional on correctness)

Verdict for the entire unchanged frozen scope (every 4-polytope with nonempty interior and at most 6 facets satisfies $V_4(\Pi K) \le \frac{160}{3}V_4(K)^3$, equality iff simplex): **SUBSTANTIAL**, conditional on the separate correctness review, which I did not perform.

**Why, after the strongest reduction.** I independently obtained the real FHLX v1 (arXiv:2610.13953 e-print/PDF/HTML, only version, 2026-08-16) and read the full TeX body. Its Section 4 supplies only the lower-bound transfer (Prop 4.1), the codim-one product $D(a)f_a(t)/(m-1)!$ (Prop 4.2), and the $n\ge9$ counterexamples plus lifting — no upper bound anywhere, no positive small-dimension or few-facet result. Project r132 (PREFREEZE) reduced the class to the sharp inequality (★) and explicitly abandoned it as its main unproved gap. The author's Lemmas 1–4/Prop A complete that reduction and are correctly credited as routine. What remains, and what I judge nonroutine: the conditional-parts HNBUE/Laplace majorization of the expectation in (★) (the tool is classical — Klefsjö 1982/1983, confirmed via Crossref abstracts — but no application to this geometric problem was located), the affine-in-scale separation to the scale-free condition $(S)_n$, and the exact ten-pattern rational certificate proving $(S)_4$ with strictness. $(S)_n$ is itself a new sharp inequality for sums of independent exponentials, true exactly at $n\le4$ and false for $n\ge5$ — a real threshold, not slack. No prior statement of the theorem, of $(S)_n$, or of the bridge was found (Saroglou 2011 read via an archive.org copy after reproducing the TLS failure; Saroglou 2015, Source P, Petty companion, and I43/r112/r131/r132 bodies checked; Brannen 1996/2005 and CFLXX bodies unreachable — disclosed). So not REDISCOVERED within stated limits, and not a routine composition, hence not TECHNICAL. Calibration is consistent with t205m/t117q (SUBSTANTIAL) versus t184i134/t106o133 (TECHNICAL).

**Honest residue.** Ingredients individually classical; $(S)_4$ is an exact computer-algebra certificate rather than a conceptual proof; scope is one dimension and one facet count; positioning requirements PQ1–PQ5 (bounded-class labelling, no priority language, credits, certificate transparency) recorded in `packet/public/review.md` §7.

**Seal and integrity.** All in `frontier/campaigns/2026-10-14/t088p133-contribution-r1/`: `packet/public/review.md` (full analysis), `reading-limits.md`, read-only `verify.py` (PASS, files=37), `controls.py` (8 tamper cases all as expected), `CONTROL-RESULTS.json`, `work/acquisition-register.json` (13 pinned blobs authenticated against the complete tree; 14 independent primary acquisitions with hashes). Detached review anchors: MANIFEST `66405c96dd6b76d25e7a290dc8d17d1f24abf489bcb2c45fd7e4deb8eef13656`, FINAL `c84fa541285ee770acf37b9df9728dee603bb40202fec6dfc868173a6069e7c7`, REPORT `89595f993f3f5ec2aa98bc87cfa30eefdaa2d4319b5f77b3c45349191e72627b` (also in `anchors.json`, `FINAL.sha256`, `REPORT.sha256`, `MANIFEST.sha256`). Author anchors re-verified against actual bytes at start and at sealing; all 39 start-hashed inputs unchanged (`unchanged.json`, 18:00:39Z); two parent-side late additions recorded; author root never written or executed in (controls ran on copies: author verify PASS, certificate PASS, geometry control PASS — artifact checks only). Active r135/t164f99 roots untouched; no git/shared-index writes, nested agents, or publication-stage actions. One transient /tmp recheck file (paths only) created and deleted, disclosed.

**Handoff.** Next gate is the independent adversarial correctness review of the frozen proof (sha256 `971506a4…2bc84`), covering the reduction details, the certificate interpretation, and the boundary/strictness/equality arguments; this review's verdict is expressly conditional on it.

---
